name: HyperFrames CLI Workflow
summary: Use the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold, inspect, validate, preview and render compositions, including configured cloud rendering.
problem: A video composition can appear complete while structural, timing or render issues remain undiscovered without the repository-native CLI checks.
coreOutcomes: Choose the relevant CLI operation for the current project stage
Run structural and visual validation before rendering
Report local and cloud-render results without conflating their evidence
requirements: The HyperFrames CLI installed or available through npx
boundaries: Cloud rendering requires its own configuration and authorization
A successful command does not by itself establish visual quality or deployment acceptance
